conventions.workflow_lens_labels: A review workflow's lens contexts are registered as claude-code-workflow:<run>:<agentId>:<record>-review-lens-<lens>-01 while the workflow journal labels the same agent ids review:<lens>; the agent id is the identity, the label is descriptive (applies to closures 157 and 159; stated here per the record-10 review nit).
conventions.workflow_agent_labels: From closure 175 on, a workflow agent is registered as claude-code-workflow:<run>:<agentId>:<label>-<form>, where <label> is the CODE RED label the workflow ran under; the forms, with the workflow journal's label in brackets: a review's lens <label>-review-lens-<lens>-01 [review:<lens>] and refuter <label>-review-refute-<lens>-<finding>-NN [refute:<lens>:<FINDING>:<N>], the finding id lowercased and NN the refuter's number in two digits; a delta review's lens and refuter the same with delta-review in place of review; a fact-check's checker <label>-factcheck-<checker>-01 [factcheck:<checker>]; a design workflow's designer <label>-design-<angle>-01 [design:<angle>] and synthesizer <label>-synthesize-<kind>-01 [synthesize:<kind>]. As in workflow_lens_labels, the agent id is the identity and the form is descriptive; an id already registered keeps the form it was registered with (closures 173 and 174 used other forms for design, refuter and synthesis agents). Stated here as DECISIONS-24 promised. From closure 188 on, a read-only check's checker is registered as <label>-check-<checker>-01 [<label>:<checker>] and its verifier as <label>-check-verify-01 [<label>:verify], the brackets giving the workflow journal's label. From closure 189 on, a survey's reader is registered as <label>-survey-<reader>-01 [<label>:<reader>] and its completeness critic as <label>-survey-critic-01 [<label>:critic]; a fact-check's checkers, a completeness critic among them, keep the form <label>-factcheck-<checker>-01, and their journals have labelled them [<label>:<checker>] since record 27's fact-check (registered in closure 179), not [factcheck:<checker>]; the brackets give the workflow journal's label. Closure 190 corrects that date, which closure 189 gave as record 36's fact-check (registered in closure 188): the form is first in closure 179's role texts, and record 10 puts convention corrections in the next closure. From closure 200 on, a workflow agent context that a container restart cut off before it returned is registered with -cut-off in place of its form's final -01 (closure 200's <label>-factcheck-<checker>-cut-off [<label>:<checker>]), and the context that ran the same role again after the resumed run is registered with -01 under its own agent id; the brackets give the workflow journal's label. Stated here in closure 201, since closure 200 used the form without naming it (record-49-reviewer-01's N3, carried by record 49).
